subject: CAIQ: log-lineage & sampling matrix request for NordicPay audit
messages:
From: Lisa Park <lisa.park@nordicpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: NordicPay Security Team <security@nordicpay.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: CAIQ: log-lineage & sampling matrix request for upcoming audit

Hi Marissa / team,

We're kicking off the CAIQ review ahead of our EU audit window (week of 2027-05-10) and need a succinct mapping from CAIQ controls to concrete runtime artifacts + a sampling approach for runtime logs. Our auditors want:

- Control-level lineage (e.g., CC7.5 / Logging -> cortex/inference-request logs -> s3://nordicpay-eu/retention/2026/*)
- A reproducible sampling matrix (how you pick time windows, tenants, and sequence lengths)
- A short sample export (1–2k rows) showing schema and redaction decisions
- Confirmation of log retention & residency (EU-only or replicated)

Can you provide a one-sheet mapping and a ready-to-download sample log slice by 2027-04-27? If there are any controls that require non-log artifacts (playbooks, attestation screenshots, KMS rotation evidence), call them out and indicate owners.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Park
Head of Security Operations, NordicPay

Attachments: none in this message
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@nordicpay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T12:25:00+01:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: log-lineage & sampling matrix request for upcoming audit

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver the mapping and a sample slice by 2027-04-27. High-level plan:

1) Deliverable: single workbook (attached) with three tabs — control-lineage, evidence-owners, and sampling-matrix. That workbook points to the concrete artifacts (S3 paths, dashboard snapshots, runbooks).

2) Sample: we'll produce a redacted log slice (~1,500 rows) exported to JSONL with a manifest describing redaction and sampling criteria. Example fields: timestamp, request_id (hashed), model_version, tenant_region, latency_ms, token_count.

3) Owners: Marcus will own the log export and runbook; Kimberly will own the CAIQ mapping verification and final sign-off. I'll coordinate packaging and secure transfer.

Open questions for you:
- Can the sample contain pseudonymized tenant IDs (we will hash tenant_id and include a deterministic salt we can share with auditors if needed)?
- Do auditors require event-level request bodies or just metadata (we usually avoid including prompt text in exported samples)?

I've attached the initial matrix (nordic_caiq_log_lineage_matrix.xlsx) and a short manifest template. Marcus — can you confirm the S3 export job / retention window and whether the EU logs are mirrored to the US?

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference
Attachments: nordic_caiq_log_lineage_matrix.xlsx, sample_manifest_template.txt
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lisa Park <lisa.park@nordicpay.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T08:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: log-lineage & sampling matrix request for upcoming audit

On 2027-04-20 12:25, Marissa Cole wrote:
> I've attached the initial matrix (nordic_caiq_log_lineage_matrix.xlsx) and a short manifest template. Marcus — can you confirm the S3 export job / retention window and whether the EU logs are mirrored to the US?

Quick tech details:
- Location: Primary logs for EU tenants are stored in s3://redwood-prod-eu/inference-logs/tenant_id={tenant_hash}/year=2026/month=04/
- Mirroring: We do not mirror EU production inference logs to the US by default for customers that require EU residency. NordicPay is on EU-only retention per the contract.
- Retention: Default 13 months for inference metadata; request bodies are retained 90 days unless the customer opts-in for longer retention.
- Export job: I will run a one-off export that applies deterministic hashing (SHA256 with per-customer salt) to tenant_id and request_id, strips prompt_text field, and retains metadata fields the auditors want. Output path: s3://redwood-sec-transfers/nordicpay/20270421/sample_log_slice.jsonl (access will be time-limited signed URL).
- Sampling approach: stratified by week + peak hour + model_version. Matrix details are in the attached workbook under tab "sampling-matrix".

Attachments in this message: sample_log_slice_manifest.jsonl (manifest only; sample data will be staged on S3).

I'll run the export 2027-04-21 14:00 UTC and share a signed URL. Kimberly — can you confirm the CAIQ control IDs we should prioritize for narrative snippets (e.g., CC7.1, CC7.5, CC9.3)?

— Marcus
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@nordicpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T16:40:00+01:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: log-lineage & sampling matrix request for upcoming audit

Thanks Marcus — and Lisa, quick confirmation from my side:

- Priority controls: CC7.1 (logging capture), CC7.5 (retention & integrity), CC9.3 (key management evidence).
- Non-log artifacts required: KMS rotation policy screenshot (KMS-console-rotation-2027-03.png), runbook excerpt for incident log retrieval (incident_runbook_v2.pdf), and a signed owner-attestation for each control (I will circulate a short form).
- Delivery timeline: I will validate the workbook and the manifest on 2027-04-23 and hand over a packaged zip with the sample by end of day 2027-04-24. Transfer will be via a time-limited S3 signed URL; we can also place the package in the Drive folder linked earlier if you prefer.

Looping Marcus on runbook export notes.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security Assurance, Redwood Inference
